title: Expanding brackets
goal: I can expand brackets using the distributive law.
teach: Multiply every term inside the bracket by the term outside: a(b + c) = ab + ac. Take care with signs: −3(x − 4) = −3x + 12.
tvis: 3(x + 5) = 3x + 15
watch: Multiply the second term too: 3(x + 5) is not 3x + 5.

qs.steps:
1. Rule (distributive law): a(b + c) = ab + ac. Multiply every term inside the brackets by the term outside, signs included.
2. 5 × 2a + 5 × (−3)
3. = 10a − 15
